Design.evidence_source: [/page/13/Text/3] Averaging across treatments, the choices of the dictators are very balanced between the selsh (49%) and the fair option (51%). Dictators' behavior is very similar across the two treatments, as 53% of the dictators in the baseline treatment and 50% of the dictators in the hidden information treatment choose the fair option (FET, p=0.816).
